**SpawnBuildRights {{VERSION}}**, released {{DATE}}

Extends vanilla spawn protection so players earn the right to build at spawn by playing. It runs on Paper, Purpur and Folia {{MINECRAFT}} with Java 25.

## Install

1. Download `SpawnBuildRights-{{VERSION}}.jar` below.
2. Put it in your server's `plugins` folder, replacing any older SpawnBuildRights jar.
3. Set `spawn-protection=0` in `server.properties`, then restart the server.

Your settings and records are kept when you upgrade. The `.sha256` file holds the jar's checksum. If something isn't working, see [troubleshooting](https://github.com/lewisgibson/spawn-build-rights/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md).
